description: This file defines a PHP class 'SugarWidgetSubPanelSendInvitesButton' that extends 'SugarWidgetSubPanelTopButton'. The class provides a method 'display' to generate an HTML button for sending invite emails, which is used in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework to render a custom button in a subpanel.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelSendInvitesButton
classes.description: A class that creates a button for sending invitation emails from a subpanel in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM, extending the base subpanel top button class.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates HTML code for a button that, when clicked, navigates to a URL to trigger sending invite emails for a specific record.
